Hotel breakfast
Feb 2025 • Couples
This review is for the breakfast included with the hotel.

Food:
Decent, not sure why it said buffet breakfast but it is a 3 courses meal. You get to order 1 appetizer, 1 main course and unlimited dessert. The food is decent if you go with the western option. The salad, western main course was very good. The asian main course (pho ga) was very underwhelming. Also comes with coffee or juice. 

Atmosphere:
Great, good table setting, open air and bright. 

Service:
Great service, very attentive and helpful.
